name: Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta. Saute garlic in olive oil, add tomato and salt. Toss with pasta.

name: Veg Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Saute onion and tomato, add eggs and cook.

name: Peanut Butter Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Spread peanut butter.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter and scramble eggs. Serve on toast.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread, add cheese, and grill in a pan until golden and melty.

name: Avocado Toast
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper. Spread on toast.

name: Banana Pancakes
instructions: Mix mashed banana, milk, egg, flour, sugar, and baking powder. Cook pancakes in butter.

name: Oatmeal with Banana
instructions: Cook oats with milk and a pinch of salt. Top with sliced banana and honey.

name: Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer yogurt, oats, berries, and drizzle with honey.

name: French Toast
instructions: Whisk egg, milk, and sugar. Dip bread and cook in butter until golden.

name: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Scramble eggs with onion and tomato. Wrap in tortilla with cheese.

name: Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend banana and yogurt. Pour in a bowl and top with oats and honey.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook pasta. Saute garlic and chili flakes in olive oil. Toss with pasta and parsley.

name: Pesto Pasta
instructions: Blend basil, garlic, olive oil, and parmesan. Toss with hot pasta.

name: Fried Rice
instructions: Saute veg in oil, add egg and scramble. Add rice and soy sauce; stir‑fry.

name: Veggie Quesadilla
instructions: Cook peppers and onion. Fill tortilla with veg and cheese; toast until crisp.

name: Tomato Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter, add tomato and broth, simmer and blend.

name: Chickpea Salad
instructions: Mix chickpea with chopped veg. Dress with lemon, olive oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Layer tomato and mozzarella. Top with basil, olive oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Stir‑fry chicken, add veg and garlic. Splash soy sauce; cook until tender‑crisp.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Cook beef with onion and chili powder. Serve in tortillas with toppings.

name: Baked Chicken and Potatoes
instructions: Toss chicken and potato with oil and spices. Bake until cooked through.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Saute garlic in butter and oil, add shrimp. Toss with pasta and parsley.

name: Veggie Stir Fry
instructions: Stir‑fry veg in oil, add garlic and soy sauce. Cook until crisp‑tender.

name: Hummus
instructions: Blend chickpea, tahini, garlic, lemon, and olive oil until smooth.

name: Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocado with onion, tomato, lime juice, and salt.

name: Fresh Tomato Salsa
instructions: Finely chop everything, mix with lime juice and salt.

name: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix minced garlic with butter and parsley. Spread on bread and toast.

name: Lemon Rice
instructions: Cook rice. Toss with lemon juice, turmeric, oil, and salt.

name: Dal Tadka
instructions: Cook lentils. Temper garlic, onion, tomato, and spices in oil; mix into lentils.

name: Chana Masala
instructions: Saute aromatics, add spices and tomato. Add chickpea and simmer.

name: Masala Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs with chopped veg and spices. Cook in a little oil.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
instructions: Mix tuna with mayo, onion, lemon, salt, pepper. Stuff between bread with lettuce.

name: Chicken Salad Wrap
instructions: Mix cooked chicken with mayo and onion. Wrap in tortilla with lettuce.

name: Potato Wedges
instructions: Toss wedges with oil and spices. Bake until crispy.

name: Sheet Pan Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Toss veg with oil, salt, pepper. Roast until tender and browned.

name: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Saute veg with garlic, toss with pasta, oil, and parmesan.

name: Mac and Cheese
instructions: Make a roux with butter and flour, add milk and cheese. Mix with cooked pasta.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
instructions: Mix all in a mug and microwave until set.

name: Fruit Salad
instructions: Chop fruit and toss with honey and lemon juice.

name: Spinach Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Saute onion and spinach in oil; add eggs and cook.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: Saute onion and garlic; add tomato and chili; simmer. Crack in eggs and cook covered.

name: Lemon Garlic Chicken
instructions: Sear chicken in oil; add garlic and lemon juice; simmer until cooked through.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Cook chicken with onion and pepper; fill tortilla with mix and cheese; toast.

name: Tuna Melt
instructions: Mix tuna, mayo, onion; spread on bread with cheese; grill in butter.

name: Veggie Club Sandwich
instructions: Layer bread with mayo, veggies, and cheese; season; slice.

name: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
instructions: Toast bread; top with chopped tomato, garlic, basil, oil, salt, pepper.

name: Tortilla Margherita Pizza
instructions: Top tortilla with tomato and mozzarella; bake or pan-toast; add basil and oil.

name: Chickpea Curry
instructions: Saute aromatics and spices; add tomato and chickpea; simmer.

name: Kidney Bean Chili
instructions: Cook onion and garlic with spices; add tomato and beans; simmer.

name: Paneer Tikka Wrap
instructions: Marinate paneer and veg in yogurt and spices; saute; wrap in tortillas.

name: Tofu Stir Fry
instructions: Stir-fry tofu and veg; add soy and garlic; cook crisp-tender.

name: Veg Noodles Stir Fry
instructions: Boil noodles; stir-fry veg with garlic and soy; toss with noodles.

name: Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Saute mushrooms and garlic; toss with pasta, parsley, parmesan.

name: Creamy Spinach Pasta
instructions: Make white sauce; add garlic/spinach; toss with pasta and parmesan.

name: Alfredo Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta; make creamy sauce; combine.

name: Garlic Mushroom Toast
instructions: Saute mushrooms with garlic and butter; spoon over toast; add parsley.

name: Burrito Bowl (Kidney Bean)
instructions: Assemble rice, beans, and veg; dress with lemon, oil, salt, pepper.

name: Chickpea Veg Wrap
instructions: Mash chickpea with lemon and oil; fill tortilla with mix and veg.

name: Pasta Salad
instructions: Toss cooked pasta with veg, oil, lemon, parsley; season.

name: Cucumber Tomato Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread; layer cucumber and tomato; season.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Mix chopped boiled eggs with mayo and onion; spread on bread.

name: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes; mix with onion, mayo, lemon, parsley; season.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato
instructions: Cube; toss with oil and spices; roast until tender.

name: Roasted Cauliflower
instructions: Toss florets with oil, garlic, spices; roast until browned.

name: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Saute onion/garlic with spices; add potato, cauliflower, tomato; cook tender.

name: Stir-fried Cabbage
instructions: Quick-fry cabbage, carrot, onion with garlic and soy.

name: Pesto Grilled Cheese
instructions: Blend basil, garlic, oil; spread on bread with cheese; grill.

name: Lemon Herb Rice
instructions: Toss cooked rice with lemon, oil, parsley, and salt.

name: Tomato Egg Drop Soup
instructions: Simmer tomato and garlic in broth; drizzle beaten egg; season.

name: Simple Chicken Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken and veg in broth; shred chicken; season.

name: Garlic Butter Chicken Bites
instructions: Sear chicken cubes; add butter and garlic; toss with parsley.

name: Chicken Rice Bowl
instructions: Stir-fry chicken with garlic and onion; add soy; serve over rice.

name: Spicy Peanut Noodles
instructions: Whisk sauce; toss with hot noodles and a bit of cooking water.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend banana, yogurt, peanut butter, honey; top with oats.

name: Veggie Omelette Wrap
instructions: Make a veggie omelette; wrap in warm tortilla.

name: Spinach Corn Sandwich
instructions: Saute spinach and corn; spread on bread with cheese; grill.

name: Corn Fried Rice
instructions: Fry onion/garlic; add rice and corn; season with soy.

name: Masala Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles; saute aromatics and spices; toss together.

name: Paneer Kathi Roll
instructions: Saute paneer with spices; smear yogurt; fill tortillas; roll.

name: Chickpea Rice
instructions: Cook spiced onion/tomato; add chickpea and rice; toss.

name: Egg Curry
instructions: Make spiced tomato-onion gravy; add boiled eggs; simmer.

name: Tomato Rice
instructions: Saute onion and garlic; add tomato; fold in cooked rice; season.

name: Lemon Garlic Broccoli
instructions: Saute broccoli with garlic; finish with lemon.

name: Baked Oats
instructions: Mix or blend; bake until set and golden.

name: Overnight Oats
instructions: Stir and chill overnight; top with banana.

name: Veggie Frittata
instructions: Saute veg; add beaten eggs and cheese; cook (stove or oven).

name: Stir-fried Green Beans
instructions: Quick-fry beans with garlic; splash soy; season.

name: Zucchini Stir Fry
instructions: Saute zucchini and onion with garlic and soy.

name: Egg Fried Noodles
instructions: Scramble egg; stir-fry onion/garlic; toss with noodles and soy.

name: Veg Pulao
instructions: Rinse 1 cup rice until water runs clear; soak 10 min. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pot (medium). Add 1/2 tsp cumin; when aromatic add 1/2 cup chopped onion and sauté 2–3 min. Add 1/3 cup diced carrot and 1/3 cup peas; sauté 2 min. Add 1/4 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp salt; stir. Add drained rice and 1 3/4 cups water; bring to boil. Cover, simmer low 12–14 min until water absorbs. Rest 5 min, fluff and serve.

name: Chickpea Spinach Curry
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan (medium). Sauté 1/2 cup chopped onion 3–4 min. Add 1 tsp minced garlic and 1/2 tsp minced ginger; cook 30 sec. Stir in 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp turmeric; cook 30 sec. Add 1 cup chopped tomato, 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 5–6 min to thicken. Stir in 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpea and 2 cups chopped spinach; cook 3–4 min until wilted. Finish with 1/2 tsp garam masala and adjust salt.

name: Paneer Bhurji
instructions: Crumble 200 g paneer. Heat 1 tbsp oil; add 1/2 tsp cumin. Sauté 1/2 cup chopped onion and 1 finely chopped green chili 3–4 min. Add 1/2 cup chopped tomato, 1/4 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp salt; cook 3–4 min until soft. Add paneer; toss 2–3 min. Finish with 1/2 tsp garam masala; serve with bread or tortillas.

name: Egg Bhurji
instructions: Beat 3 eggs with a pinch of salt/pepper. Heat 1 tbsp oil; sauté 1/3 cup chopped onion and 1 small chopped green chili 2–3 min. Add 1/3 cup chopped tomato and 1/4 tsp turmeric; cook 2 min. Pour eggs; scramble gently 2–3 min until just set. Adjust salt; serve hot.

name: Hearty Lentil Soup
instructions: Rinse 1 cup lentils. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pot; sauté 1/2 cup diced onion and 1/2 cup diced carrot 3–4 min. Add 2 minced garlic cloves; 30 sec. Add lentils and 4 cups vegetable broth, 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 20–25 min until tender. Season with pepper; blend half for creaminess (optional).

name: Egg Fried Rice (Street-Style)
instructions: Use 2 cups cold cooked rice. Beat 2 eggs with a pinch of salt. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok (high). Scramble eggs softly; remove. Add 1 tbsp oil, sauté 1/3 cup finely chopped onion and 1 minced garlic clove 45 sec. Add rice; toss 1–2 min. Splash 1–1.5 tbsp soy sauce; toss. Return eggs; pepper to taste.

name: Veg Ramen Bowl
instructions: Heat 1 tsp oil; sauté 1 minced garlic clove and 1 tsp minced ginger 30 sec. Add 3 cups vegetable broth and 1–2 tbsp soy sauce; simmer 3–4 min. Add 1 cup sliced mushroom; cook 3 min. Add noodles; cook per pack minus 30 sec. Stir in 2 cups spinach until wilted; season.

name: Caprese Sandwich
instructions: Lightly toast bread. Layer tomato slices, mozzarella, and basil. Drizzle olive oil; season with salt/pepper. Press, slice, and serve immediately.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
instructions: Cook pasta al dente; reserve 1/2 cup water. Sauté 2 sliced garlic cloves in 2 tbsp olive oil (medium) 30–60 sec. Add 1/2–1 tsp chili flakes and 1 1/2 cups crushed tomato, 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 8–10 min. Toss with pasta, adding splash of pasta water until glossy.

name: Broccoli Alfredo Pasta
instructions: Blanch 2 cups small broccoli florets 2 min; drain. Cook pasta; reserve water. Melt 2 tbsp butter; sauté 1 minced garlic clove 30 sec. Whisk in 1 tbsp flour; cook 1 min. Gradually add 1 1/4 cups warm milk; simmer 3–4 min. Stir in 1/2 cup parmesan, salt/pepper. Toss pasta and broccoli; thin with pasta water if needed.

name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat 220°C/425°F. Toss 600 g diced potato with 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1/2 tsp salt, pepper. Spread on tray; roast 25–30 min, flipping once. Toss hot with 1/3 cup grated parmesan.

name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
instructions: Pat dry 2 cups cooked chickpea. Toss with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp salt, pepper. Roast at 200°C/400°F for 25–30 min, shaking pan once, until crisp.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Combine chunks of cucumber, tomato, and thin onion slices with pitted olives and diced feta. Dress with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, salt, pepper; toss gently.

name: Panzanella Salad
instructions: Toast bread cubes with a little oil until crisp. Toss with chopped tomato, cucumber, and thin onion. Dress with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon, salt, pepper; rest 10 min to soak.

name: Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch 4 cups spinach 1 min; blend. Heat 1 tbsp oil; add 1/2 tsp cumin, then 1/2 cup onion; sauté 3–4 min. Add 1 tsp garlic, 1/2 tsp ginger; 30 sec. Add 1/2 cup tomato, 1/2 tsp salt; cook 4–5 min. Stir in spinach puree and 1/2 cup water; simmer 3 min. Add paneer cubes; heat 2 min. Finish with 1/2 tsp garam masala.

name: Chicken Tacos
instructions: Sauté 300 g diced chicken in 1 tbsp oil with 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1 minced garlic clove, salt/pepper until cooked. Warm tortillas. Fill with chicken, shredded lettuce, diced tomato, and cheese.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook and cool pasta. Mix 1 can tuna (drained) with 1/4 cup mayo, 2 tbsp finely chopped onion, 1/2 cup chopped cucumber, 1 tsp lemon juice, salt/pepper. Fold in pasta; chill 20 min.

name: Baked Egg Muffins
instructions: Grease a muffin tin. Whisk 6 eggs with salt/pepper. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped spinach, 1/4 cup diced onion, 1/4 cup diced bell pepper, 1/3 cup shredded cheese. Fill cups and bake at 190°C/375°F for 14–16 min.

name: Oat Pancakes
instructions: Blend 1 cup oats to flour. Mix with 1 mashed banana, 1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tsp baking powder, pinch salt. Cook small pancakes on a lightly oiled pan 2–3 min per side. Drizzle honey.

name: Smashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil small potatoes until tender; drain. Smash gently on a tray. Brush with oil, sprinkle minced garlic, salt/pepper. Roast at 220°C/425°F for 20–25 min until crisp.

name: Tomato Cucumber Raita
instructions: Whisk 1 cup yogurt with 1/4 tsp salt. Stir in 1/2 cup finely chopped cucumber and 1/4 cup chopped tomato. Pepper to taste; chill 10 min.

name: Garlic Soy Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Heat 1 tbsp oil; sauté 2 minced garlic cloves 30 sec. Add noodles; toss with 1–2 tbsp soy sauce and pepper. Top with chopped spring onion.

name: Spinach Chickpea Salad Bowl
instructions: Toss baby spinach with cooked chickpea, chopped cucumber, tomato, and a little onion. Dress with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon, salt/pepper.

name: Chicken Tomato Rice (One-Pot)
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup onion and 1 minced garlic clove in 1 tbsp oil. Add 300 g diced chicken; brown 2–3 min. Stir in 1 cup rice and 1 cup chopped tomato; season. Add 2 cups water; simmer covered 15–18 min until rice is done.

name: Mushroom Fried Rice
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil (high). Sauté 1 cup sliced mushroom until browned; add 1/4 cup onion and 1 minced garlic clove; 1 min. Add 2 cups cold rice and 1–1.5 tbsp soy sauce; toss 1–2 min. Pepper to taste.

name: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 minced garlic clove, salt/pepper 10 min. Bake at 200°C/400°F for 18–20 min or until cooked through; rest 5 min and slice.

name: Tomato Corn Soup
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup onion in 1 tbsp oil 3 min. Add 1 minced garlic clove; 30 sec. Add 2 cups chopped tomato, 1 cup corn, 2 cups broth, 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 12–15 min. Blend partly; season.

name: Veggie Tortilla Pockets
instructions: Spread a thin layer of mayo on tortillas. Fill with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, cucumber, and onion. Season lightly; fold and toast 1–2 min per side on a dry pan.

name: Paneer Tikka Sandwich
instructions: Marinate paneer cubes with 2 tbsp yogurt, 1/2 tsp garam masala, pinch cumin/turmeric, and salt 10 min. Sauté in 1 tsp oil 3–4 min. Stuff in bread with onion/tomato; grill to golden.

name: Tomato Basil Egg Skillet
instructions: Sauté 1 minced garlic clove in 1 tbsp oil 30 sec. Add 1 1/2 cups chopped tomato and 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 5–6 min. Make 2–3 wells; crack eggs; cover and cook on low 4–6 min until whites set. Finish with basil.

name: Spinach Pesto Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta al dente; reserve 1/2 cup water. Blend 2 cups spinach, 1 garlic clove, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/3 cup parmesan, squeeze of lemon, pinch of salt. Toss with hot pasta, loosening with pasta water until glossy.

name: Roasted Veg Couscous
instructions: Roast diced bell pepper and onion with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper at 200°C/400°F for 12–15 min. Cover 1 cup couscous with 1 cup boiling water + pinch salt; rest 7 min and fluff. Fold in roasted veg; drizzle olive oil.

name: Tuna Lemon Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. In pan, warm 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 minced garlic clove 30 sec. Add drained tuna, zest + juice of 1/2 lemon; toss 1 min. Add pasta, parsley, salt/pepper; loosen with pasta water.

name: Chicken Pesto Wrap
instructions: Sear thin chicken strips with salt/pepper 4–6 min total. Blitz basil, garlic, oil, parmesan into a quick pesto. Spread on tortillas, add lettuce and chicken; roll and toast 1–2 min per side.

name: Rice and Beans Bowl
instructions: Sauté onion in 1 tbsp oil, add 1/2 tsp cumin, chopped tomato; cook 2–3 min. Stir in cooked kidney beans, salt/pepper. Serve over hot rice; drizzle oil.

name: Veggie Fajitas
instructions: Sear sliced peppers/onion in hot pan with 1 tbsp oil, 1/2 tsp cumin, salt/pepper until charred‑tender. Warm tortillas; fill and serve.

name: Egg and Tomato Stir Fry
instructions: Beat eggs with salt/pepper. Sauté onion 2 min, add chopped tomato 2–3 min. Pour eggs; scramble gently until just set.

name: Peanut Noodle Salad
instructions: Whisk 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1–1.5 tbsp soy, 1 tsp lemon, 1 tsp honey with a splash of warm water. Toss cooked noodles with thin carrot/cucumber and the sauce.

name: Garlic Butter Corn
instructions: Melt 1 tbsp butter; sizzle 1 minced garlic clove 30 sec. Add 1.5 cups corn; cook 2–3 min. Salt/pepper to taste.

name: Avocado Egg Sandwich
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon, salt/pepper. Scramble or fry eggs. Layer on toasted bread; close and serve.

name: Chickpea Tuna Salad
instructions: Combine drained tuna and cooked chickpea with finely chopped onion, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp lemon, salt/pepper.

name: Peas Lemon Rice
instructions: Sauté 1/4 tsp turmeric in 1 tsp oil. Add 1 cup cooked rice, 1/2 cup peas, salt; toss. Finish with lemon juice.

name: Garlic Spinach Rice
instructions: Sauté 1 minced garlic clove in 1 tsp oil, add 2 cups chopped spinach; wilt. Fold into 1 cup hot cooked rice; salt to taste.

name: Potato Corn Sandwich
instructions: Mix mashed boiled potato with corn, salt/pepper. Spread between bread; butter outside and grill to golden.

name: Paneer Stir Fry
instructions: Sear paneer cubes in 1 tsp oil; remove. Sauté peppers/onion with 1 minced garlic clove; splash soy. Return paneer; toss 1 min.

name: Tofu Fried Rice
instructions: Crisp tofu cubes in 1 tbsp oil; remove. Sauté onion/garlic; add cold rice and 1–1.5 tbsp soy; toss hot. Return tofu; pepper to taste.

name: Mushroom Egg Toast
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter 3–4 min; salt. Fry or scramble eggs. Pile mushrooms and eggs on toast.

name: Basil Egg Toast
instructions: Sizzle 1 chopped garlic clove in 1 tsp oil; add chopped basil for 10 sec. Scramble eggs in the fragrant oil; serve on toast.

name: Chickpea Tomato Pasta
instructions: Sauté garlic in oil 30 sec; add crushed tomato, salt; simmer 6–8 min. Stir in chickpea 2 min. Toss with pasta.

name: Spinach Corn Pasta
instructions: Sauté garlic in oil; add corn 1 min, spinach until wilted. Toss with hot pasta, parmesan, salt/pepper.

name: Chicken Tomato Sandwich
instructions: Pan‑cook thin chicken with salt/pepper; slice. Layer bread with mayo, lettuce, tomato, chicken; close.

name: Garlic Herb Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with 1 tbsp oil, minced garlic, lemon juice, salt/pepper 10 min. Sear 4–6 min per side; rest and slice. Sprinkle parsley.

name: Sesame Garlic Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles. Heat 1 tsp oil; sizzle 1 minced garlic clove 20–30 sec. Toss noodles with 1–1.5 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, pepper; top with chopped spring onion.

name: Egg Rice Bowl
instructions: Fry eggs sunny‑side or scramble. Serve over hot rice with 1–2 tsp soy, pepper, and spring onion.

name: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Sauté onion in butter 3 min. Add 2 cups broccoli, 2 cups broth; simmer 8–10 min. Stir in 1 cup milk and 1 cup cheddar; melt. Season.

name: Tomato Cheese Omelette
instructions: Cook chopped tomato 1 min in 1 tsp oil. Add beaten eggs; when nearly set, add cheese and fold.

name: Chickpea Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Mash chickpea slightly with onion/tomato. Dress with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp lemon, salt/pepper. Spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Garlic Lemon Green Beans
instructions: Sauté trimmed beans in 1 tbsp oil 4–5 min. Add 1 minced garlic clove 30 sec; finish with lemon, salt/pepper.

name: Veggie Pasta Bake
instructions: Mix cooked pasta with crushed tomato, 1 tbsp oil, salt/pepper. Top with mozzarella; bake at 200°C/400°F 12–15 min. Finish with basil.

name: Spinach Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble eggs; remove. Sauté garlic and spinach 1–2 min. Add cold rice, 1–1.5 tbsp soy; toss hot. Return eggs.

name: Yogurt Chicken Wrap
instructions: Marinate strips with 2 tbsp yogurt, garlic, lemon, salt/pepper 10–15 min. Sear 5–6 min total. Wrap with lettuce/onion.

name: Eggplant Tomato Pasta
instructions: Cube eggplant; sauté in 2 tbsp oil until tender/golden. Add garlic 30 sec, crushed tomato + salt; simmer 6–8 min. Toss with pasta and basil.

name: Tomato Corn Salad
instructions: Combine diced tomato, corn, and a little onion. Dress with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp lemon, salt/pepper.

name: Garlic Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Sear chicken with minced garlic, salt/pepper; slice thin. Fill tortilla with chicken and cheese; toast until melted.

name: Mushroom Quesadilla
instructions: Sauté sliced mushroom/onion until browned; salt/pepper. Fill tortilla with mix and cheese; toast to golden.

name: Paneer Fried Rice
instructions: Brown paneer cubes; remove. Sauté onion/garlic; add peas, cold rice, 1–1.5 tbsp soy; toss hot. Return paneer.

name: Chickpea Pulao
instructions: Sauté onion in 1 tbsp oil; add 1/2 tsp cumin, pinch turmeric. Stir in 1 cup rice, 1.75 cups water, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup chickpea. Simmer covered 12–14 min.

name: Spicy Tomato Noodles
instructions: Sauté garlic and chili flakes in 1 tbsp oil 30 sec; add crushed tomato + salt; simmer 5–6 min. Toss with cooked noodles.

name: Veggie Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Pan‑roast diced potato with oil, salt/pepper until tender/crisp. Sauté onion/pepper 2–3 min; combine. Top with fried or scrambled eggs.

name: Lemon Garlic Roasted Cauliflower Steaks
instructions: Slice cauliflower into 2 cm steaks. Brush with oil, minced garlic, lemon, salt/pepper. Roast 220°C/425°F 20–25 min, flipping once.

name: Veg Paella Rice
instructions: Rinse 1 cup rice; drain. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil (medium); sauté 1/2 cup chopped onion and 1 minced garlic clove 2–3 min. Add 1/2 cup diced bell pepper, 1/2 cup peas; cook 2 min. Stir in 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup chopped tomato; cook 2–3 min. Add rice + 1 3/4 cups water; boil, then cover and simmer low 14–16 min. Rest 5 min; fluff.

name: Lemon Butter Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta al dente; reserve 1/2 cup water. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a pan (medium‑low); add 1 minced garlic clove 30 sec. Add zest + juice of 1/2 lemon and a splash of pasta water. Toss in pasta until glossy; salt/pepper to taste.

name: Spinach Tomato Pasta Bake
instructions: Cook pasta 1 min less than al dente; drain. Mix with 1 1/2 cups crushed tomato, 2 cups chopped spinach, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt. Top with mozzarella; bake 200°C/400°F for 12–15 min until bubbly.

name: Eggplant Chickpea Masala
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup onion in 1 tbsp oil 3–4 min. Add 1 tsp garlic, 1/2 tsp ginger; 30 sec. Stir in 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp turmeric; 30 sec. Add 1 1/2 cups chopped eggplant; cook 5–6 min. Add 1 cup tomato, 1 cup chickpea, 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 6–8 min. Finish with 1/2 tsp garam masala.

name: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Roast 4 cups chopped tomato with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt at 200°C/400°F for 15 min. Sauté 1/2 cup onion + 1 minced garlic clove 2 min; add tomatoes and 2 cups broth; simmer 8–10 min. Blend smooth; season; stir in torn basil.

name: Tuna Corn Mayo Sandwich
instructions: Mix 1 can tuna (drained) with 1/3 cup corn, 2 tbsp finely chopped onion, 2–3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp lemon, salt/pepper. Spread on bread; toast or serve as is.

name: Classic Cheese Omelette
instructions: Beat 2–3 eggs with salt/pepper. Melt 1 tsp butter in a nonstick pan (medium‑low). Pour eggs; when mostly set, add 1/3 cup grated cheese; fold and cook 30–60 sec.

name: Mushroom Rice Pilaf
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup sliced mushroom in 1 tbsp oil (medium‑high) until browned. Add 1/4 cup onion + 1 minced garlic clove; 1 min. Stir in 1 cup rinsed rice, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 3/4 cups water; simmer covered 12–14 min. Rest 5 min; fluff.

name: Big Veggie Burrito
instructions: Warm tortilla. Fill with hot rice and warmed kidney beans. Add shredded lettuce, diced tomato/onion, and cheese. Season; roll tight and toast seam‑side down 1–2 min.

name: Crisp Chickpea Patties
instructions: Mash 1 1/2 cups chickpea with 2 tbsp finely chopped onion, 1 minced garlic clove, 1/2 tsp cumin, 2–3 tbsp flour, 1/2 tsp salt, pepper. Form small patties; pan‑fry in 2 tbsp oil 3–4 min/side.

name: Potato Latke Pancakes
instructions: Grate 2 potatoes and 2 tbsp onion; squeeze dry. Mix with 1 egg, 2 tbsp flour, 1/2 tsp salt, pepper. Pan‑fry small scoops in 2–3 tbsp oil 3–4 min/side till crisp.

name: Zucchini Pan Fritters
instructions: Grate 1 medium zucchini; squeeze dry. Mix with 1 egg, 2 tbsp finely chopped onion, 2–3 tbsp flour, 1/4 tsp salt, pepper. Fry spoonfuls in 2 tbsp oil 2–3 min/side.

name: Caprese Panini Melt
instructions: Layer tomato, mozzarella, and basil on bread; season. Brush outside with oil; grill in a pan or press until golden and melty.

name: Lemon Pepper Chicken Skillet
instructions: Season chicken with 1/4 tsp salt and plenty of pepper. Sear in 1 tbsp oil 4–5 min/side. Add 1 minced garlic clove and juice of 1/2 lemon; simmer 1–2 min. Rest and slice.

name: Honey Roasted Carrots
instructions: Toss carrot batons with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp honey, 1/2 tsp salt, pepper. Roast 200°C/400°F for 18–22 min until tender and caramelized.

name: Chili Garlic Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Sizzle 2 minced garlic cloves and 1/2–1 tsp chili flakes in 1 tbsp oil 30 sec. Toss noodles with 1–1.5 tbsp soy; adjust salt.

name: Soy Cucumber Salad
instructions: Smash/slice cucumbers; pat dry. Dress with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp lemon, 1 tsp olive oil. Chill 10 min; serve.

name: Simple Coleslaw Salad
instructions: Shred 2 cups cabbage and 1/2 cup carrot. Toss with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp lemon, 1/4 tsp salt, pepper.

name: Tomato Basil Couscous
instructions: Pour 1 cup boiling water over 1 cup couscous + pinch salt; cover 7 min. Fluff; fold in diced tomato, chopped basil, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt/pepper.

name: Chickpea Tomato Toasts
instructions: Mash chickpea with 1 tbsp olive oil, pinch salt/pepper. Toast bread; rub lightly with cut garlic. Top with mash and diced tomato.

name: Spinach Mushroom Quesadilla
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms in 1 tsp oil; add 2 cups spinach to wilt; salt lightly. Fill tortilla with mix and cheese; toast both sides to golden.

name: Broccoli Garlic Stir‑Fry
instructions: Sear broccoli florets in 1 tbsp oil 3–4 min (high). Add 2 minced garlic cloves; 30 sec. Splash 1 tbsp soy; toss 30 sec. Pepper to taste.

name: Fried Egg Breakfast Sandwich
instructions: Fry an egg in 1 tsp butter; salt/pepper. Toast bread with cheese to melt. Sandwich the egg; serve hot.

name: Peanut Oat Energy Bites
instructions: Mix 1 cup oats, 1/2 cup peanut butter, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp cocoa, pinch salt. Chill 10 min; roll into bite‑size balls.

name: 2‑Ingredient Banana Oat Cookies
instructions: Mash 2 ripe bananas; mix with 1 1/2 cups oats and 1–2 tsp honey. Spoon onto tray; bake 175°C/350°F for 12–14 min.

name: Yogurt Berry Bowl
instructions: Top 1 cup yogurt with a handful of berries, 1–2 tsp honey, and 2 tbsp oats for crunch.

name: Chili Lemon Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Sizzle 1 minced garlic clove and 1/2–1 tsp chili flakes in 2 tbsp oil 30 sec. Toss in pasta with lemon juice; salt to taste.

name: Rustic Minestrone Soup
instructions: Sauté onion/carrot in 1 tbsp oil 3 min; add 1 minced garlic clove 30 sec. Add 3 cups broth, 1 cup chopped tomato, 1/2 cup small pasta, 1 cup kidney beans, 1/2 tsp salt. Simmer 10–12 min; pepper to taste.

name: Chickpea Tikka Masala
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup onion in 1 tbsp oil 3–4 min. Add 1 tsp garlic, 1/2 tsp ginger; 30 sec. Stir in 1 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/4 tsp turmeric; 30 sec. Add 1 1/2 cups tomato, 1 1/2 cups chickpea, 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 8–10 min.

name: Paneer Tomato Masala
instructions: Brown paneer cubes in 1 tsp oil; remove. Sauté 1/2 cup onion 3 min; add 1 tsp garlic, 1/2 tsp ginger 30 sec. Add 1/4 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp salt; stir 30 sec. Add 1 cup tomato; simmer 5–6 min. Return paneer; finish with 1/2 tsp garam masala.

name: Veg Stir‑Fry Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Sear sliced pepper/onion/carrot in 1 tbsp oil 2–3 min (high). Add 1 minced garlic clove; 30 sec. Toss noodles with 1–2 tbsp soy; season.

name: Potato Chickpea Curry
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup onion in 1 tbsp oil 3–4 min. Add 1 tsp garlic, 1/2 tsp ginger; 30 sec. Add 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/4 tsp turmeric; 30 sec. Add 2 cups diced potato, 1 cup tomato, 1 1/2 cups chickpea, 1/2 tsp salt; add 1 cup water; simmer 12–15 min until potatoes are tender.

name: Spinach Corn Quesadilla
instructions: Wilt 2 cups spinach in 1 tsp oil; salt lightly. Add 1/2 cup corn; 1 min. Fill tortilla with mix and cheese; toast both sides to golden.

name: Eggplant Tomato Sandwich
instructions: Pan‑roast thin eggplant slices in 1 tbsp oil until tender; salt/pepper. Layer with tomato on bread; toast to warm through.

name: Garlic Herb Rice
instructions: Cook 1 cup rice. Sizzle 1 minced garlic clove in 1 tbsp olive oil 30–45 sec; fold into hot rice with 1–2 tbsp chopped parsley and 1/4 tsp salt.

name: Lentil Tomato Stew
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup onion in 1 tbsp oil 3 min; add 1 minced garlic clove 30 sec. Add 1 cup lentils, 3 cups broth, 1 cup chopped tomato, 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 20–25 min until lentils are tender. Pepper to taste.

name: Avocado Chickpea Salad
instructions: Mash 1 ripe avocado with 1/2 tsp lemon and pinch salt. Fold in 1 cup chickpea and 2 tbsp finely chopped onion; pepper to taste.

name: Garlic Shrimp Rice Bowl
instructions: Sear shrimp in 1 tbsp oil with 1 minced garlic clove 1–2 min/side; salt/pepper. Serve over hot rice with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Tomato Basil Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup chopped tomato in 1 tsp oil 1–2 min. Add beaten eggs; scramble softly. Finish with torn basil, salt/pepper.

name: Lemon Garlic Roasted Zucchini
instructions: Toss sliced zucchini with 1 tbsp oil, 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tsp lemon juice, 1/4 tsp salt, pepper. Roast 220°C/425°F 10–12 min until tender.

name: Black Bean Burgers
instructions: Mash beans with chopped onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, cumin, salt, and pepper. Form patties and pan-fry in oil until crisp on both sides.

name: Lemon Dill Salmon
instructions: Place salmon on foil. Top with lemon slices, fresh dill, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Bake at 200°C/400°F for 12-15 min.

name: Coconut Curry Lentils
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add curry powder, lentils, and coconut milk. Simmer for 20-25 min until lentils are tender; season with salt.

name: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Cut sweet potato into fries. Toss with oil, paprika, garlic powder, and salt. Bake at 220°C/425°F for 20-25 min, flipping once.

name: Miso Glazed Eggplant
instructions: Whisk miso, soy sauce, and honey. Brush mixture over sliced eggplant. Roast at 200°C/400°F for 15-20 min until tender and caramelized.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
instructions: Cook oats with milk. Stir in chopped apple, a pinch of cinnamon, and a drizzle of honey before serving.

name: Simple Berry Smoothie
instructions: Blend a handful of mixed berries, half a banana, a scoop of yogurt, a splash of milk, and a little honey until smooth.

name: Veggie Lentil Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Cook lentils with diced carrot, onion, and peas in broth. Top with mashed potatoes (potato, butter, milk, salt). Bake at 190°C/375°F for 15 min.

name: Creamy Mushroom Soup
instructions: Sauté mushrooms and onion in butter. Stir in garlic and flour. Gradually add broth and milk; simmer until thick. Blend and season.

name: Quinoa Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
instructions: Cook and cool quinoa. Toss with chopped cucumber, tomato, and onion. Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Garlic Parmesan Zucchini Noodles
instructions: Spiralize or julienne zucchini. Sauté minced garlic in oil for 30 sec. Add zucchini noodles, toss for 1-2 min. Remove from heat; add parmesan, salt, and pepper.

name: One-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken & Asparagus
instructions: Toss chicken and asparagus with oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, pepper on a baking sheet. Bake at 200°C/400°F for 20-25 min.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-fry
instructions: Sear beef strips in a hot pan; remove. Stir-fry broccoli and garlic. Return beef, add soy sauce and a touch of honey; toss to combine.

name: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Sauté spinach with garlic; mix with feta. Cut a pocket in chicken breasts; stuff with mixture. Sear and bake at 190°C/375°F for 15-20 min.

name: Chocolate Avocado Mousse
instructions: Blend a ripe avocado, cocoa powder, honey, a splash of milk, and a pinch of salt until perfectly smooth. Chill before serving.

name: Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Grate cauliflower or pulse in a food processor. Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add cauliflower rice and cook for 3-5 min until tender. Season.

name: Black Bean and Corn Salsa
instructions: Combine canned black beans, corn, chopped onion, and tomato. Dress with lime juice, fresh cilantro, and salt.

name: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Melt butter in a pan; sauté minced garlic for 30 sec. Add shrimp, cook 1-2 min per side. Squeeze lemon juice, add parsley, salt, and pepper.

name: Honey Garlic Glazed Salmon
instructions: Mix honey, soy sauce, and minced garlic. Sear salmon in a pan with oil. Pour sauce over and cook for 2-3 min until glaze thickens.

name: Gnocchi with Sage Butter Sauce
instructions: Cook gnocchi per package. Melt butter in a pan, add fresh sage leaves and cook until crisp. Toss with gnocchi, parmesan, salt, and pepper.

name: Potato Leek Soup
instructions: Sauté chopped leeks and onion in butter. Add garlic, potato, and broth. Simmer until potatoes are soft. Blend until smooth and season.

name: White Bean Tuna Salad
instructions: Gently mix drained tuna, canned white beans, finely chopped onion, parsley, lemon juice, and olive oil. Season with salt.

name: Curried Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix cooked, shredded chicken with mayo, chopped onion, curry powder, a squeeze of lemon, and salt. Serve chilled.

name: Lentil Sloppy Joes
instructions: Sauté onion, add spices, tomato sauce, and cooked lentils. Simmer for 10 min until thick. Serve on toasted buns.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic; mix with cooked rice, chopped tomato, and salt. Stuff into halved bell peppers, top with cheese. Bake at 190°C/375°F for 20 min.

name: Corn Chowder
instructions: Sauté onion in butter. Stir in flour, then milk. Add diced potato and corn; simmer until potatoes are tender. Season.

name: Creamed Spinach
instructions: Sauté garlic in butter. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Stir in a splash of milk and parmesan cheese until creamy. Season.

name: Baked Falafel
instructions: Blend all ingredients (except oil). Form into small patties. Brush with oil and bake at 200°C/400°F for 20-25 min, flipping once.

name: Tabbouleh Salad
instructions: Finely chop a large bunch of parsley. Mix with diced tomato, very finely chopped onion, lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.

name: Sausage and Kale Pasta
instructions: Cook sausage; remove. Sauté garlic and chili flakes, add kale and wilt. Toss with cooked pasta, sausage, and parmesan.

name: Simplified Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Coat chicken in egg and breadcrumb/parmesan mix. Pan-fry until golden. Top with tomato sauce and mozzarella; bake until cheese melts.

name: Fish Tacos
instructions: Season fish with chili powder; pan-sear and flake. Serve in tortillas with shredded cabbage and a drizzle of lime-mayo sauce.

name: Butternut Squash Soup
instructions: Roast cubed squash until tender. Sauté onion and garlic, add squash and broth. Simmer for 10 min, then blend until smooth and season.

name: Simple Apple Crumble
instructions: Place sliced apples in a dish. Mix flour, oats, sugar, and cinnamon; rub in cold butter to make a crumble. Top apples and bake at 180°C/350°F for 30 min.

name: Onion Bhaji Fritters
instructions: Thinly slice onions. Mix with flour, spices, salt, and a little water to form a thick batter. Fry spoonfuls in hot oil until golden and crisp.

name: 3-Ingredient Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix 1 cup peanut butter, 1 cup sugar, and 1 egg. Roll into balls, press with a fork. Bake at 180°C/350°F for 10-12 minutes.

name: Cacio e Pepe
instructions: Cook pasta; reserve 1 cup of starchy water. Drain pasta. Toss vigorously with lots of black pepper, grated parmesan, and splashes of pasta water until a creamy sauce forms.

name: Shredded Chicken Tostadas
instructions: Fry tortillas flat until crisp. Top with cooked shredded chicken, lettuce, tomato, and cheese.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Pasta
instructions: Roast red bell peppers until charred; peel and blend with garlic, oil, and salt. Toss with hot pasta and parmesan.

name: Sautéed Swiss Chard
instructions: Sauté chopped garlic in oil for 30 seconds. Add chopped swiss chard and cook until wilted. Finish with a squeeze of lemon and salt.

name: Watermelon Feta Salad
instructions: Cube watermelon and gently toss with crumbled feta cheese and fresh mint leaves. Drizzle with a little olive oil and lime juice.

name: French Dip Sandwiches (Simple)
instructions: Slow cook beef until tender; shred. Sauté onions. Serve beef and onions on buttered, toasted bread with a side of the warm cooking broth for dipping.

name: Spicy Edamame
instructions: Steam edamame. Sauté garlic and chili flakes in oil for 30 sec. Toss with edamame and a splash of soy sauce.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta; reserve 1/2 cup water. Whisk ricotta with lemon zest, juice, and parmesan. Toss with hot pasta, using pasta water to create a creamy sauce. Season.

name: Crispy Tofu Bites
instructions: Press tofu dry and cube it. Toss with cornstarch, soy sauce, and garlic powder. Pan-fry or bake at 200°C/400°F until golden and crisp.

name: Pork and Apple Skillet
instructions: Sear pork chops; set aside. In the same pan, sauté sliced onion and apple in butter until soft. Return pork to pan to warm through.

name: Avocado and Corn Salad
instructions: Gently combine diced avocado, corn, finely chopped onion, and cilantro. Dress with lime juice and salt.

name: Coconut Rice
instructions: Rinse rice. Cook with a mix of half coconut milk, half water (total liquid as per rice instructions) and a pinch of salt. Fluff before serving.

name: Tzatziki Sauce Dip
instructions: Grate cucumber and squeeze out excess water. Mix with yogurt, minced garlic, lemon juice, chopped dill, and salt. Chill for 30 minutes.

name: Caramelized Onion and Goat Cheese Tart
instructions: Slowly cook sliced onions in butter with a pinch of sugar and salt until deeply caramelized. Spread on a tortilla, crumble goat cheese on top, and bake until crisp.
